text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Not going anywhere... huh? 
...Did you not plan anything for City 
Presents Day!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, I actually planned properly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"What the heck~, then spill it! 
City's date plans have gotta be amazing, I 
was totally looking forward to it♡"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"............Well, let's just sit down for 
now. 
The chairs here are super plush and comfy, 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... well, so basically, for today... 
we should, like, take our time... 
and enjoy the hotel... that's the plan... 
I mean, this place... is... so..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...............Huh? Wait, City-san? 
...Did your highness just doze off? 
For real? ............Heeeeeey~~!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(Haaah... I don't really mind staying at 
the hotel. But going to sleep, seriously? 
I was so ready to have tons of fun with 
City... I even woke up early and 
everything.)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(City's always like this, honestly. Like 
she never gets hyped up, 
and whenever we hang out, it's always me 
initiating. Even before we became 
friends!)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, hey, it's Gold City! We're heading to 
karaoke right now, 
wanna come along? I've always wondered 
what kind of songs you sing~."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, stop it, Jordan. 
There's no way she'd hang out with 
bottom-feeders like us. She's a model, 
y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll pass. 
See ya—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, work? It's not, right? If you're 
just going home, why not? 
Come on, come on! I've got a coupon we can 
use today, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, I kept pestering her forever, and 
she finally gave in. 
If I hadn't pushed for the Summer Walk in 
the first place—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait... with you, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait? Was that just her going along 
with the vibe... right? 
No, no way, what am I thinking? There's no 
way she was seriously—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm worried. Whenever Jordan gets too 
hyped, 
nothing good ever happens."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(—No way, right? What if she actually 
hated all of it for real...? 
Ha ha... Wait, what? ...Did I mess up? Did 
I just ignore her feelings?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...City's always so nice... Did I force 
her to put up with me? 
Wanting to hang out, looking forward to 
it, all of it—)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Was it really just me, the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wooohooo!! 
Run, Bestieeee!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, Palmer and Helios... and Bamboo-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heyyyy! 
Palmer! Helios!! Just give it up and let 
me catch you already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! 
Not good, Helios! Bamboo's kicking into 
high gear from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! She's totally crazy fast, watch 
out Pal-chin! 
Btw, I'm pretty much doooone for～～～～☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way, Helios...! In that case, I'll go 
down with—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, Pal-chin! Win this... for the both of 
us! 
Go for it, Bestieeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What are they even doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Must be nice, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
("Besties"... huh. 
...What about me—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...What about it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My bad, I totally passed out... But 
Helios-san's stupidly loud laugh 
woke me up. What are they even doing over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... I have no idea either. Probably 
just Helios and Palmer 
goofing off and Bamboo-san chasing them 
down.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense. So, what did you mean by 
"must be nice"?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! 
Ah, um... Huh? Did I... say something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You mean having fun like Helios-san and 
her? 
Isn't that what you were thinking?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm really sorry I fell asleep. It just 
hit me all of a sudden... 
If you're mad, just say so. I'll 
apologize...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that... Really, it's fine. 
If anything... I'm the one who should be 
apologizing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why? 
...If you have something to say, just spit 
it out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Th-that's...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fuuuu! What's up, party gyals over there! 
You're hyped today too, huh~ Wanna dance 
with me? On top of the ocean! Totally 
hype☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're already caught, so sit still! 
Are City and Jordan just taking it 
easy...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hmmm...?  
...City, aren't you looking a little down?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
! ...Nah, not really. 
...I'm gonna go grab some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait up a sec—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san! 
...Just leave it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Leave what...? What do you mean? 
City was acting weird, so I just wanted to 
ask her about it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't ask! ...I don't wanna hear it. So... 
it's fine. 
It's fine... Just leave it like that!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaa?! What's up with that?! 
Jordaaaan~~~~??

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! 
Come on, what is going on here?!
